형들은 우리가 요셉을 팔아서 그렇다고 옥신각신함. 그 장면을 보면서 요셉: The brothers argue among themselves that this is happening because they sold Joseph. Watching that scene, Joseph wonders, have my brothers changed a bit? and puts them in prison for now. Three days later he releases them, but keeps only Simeon as a hostage and sends the brothers off, telling them that since they'll eventually come back, bring Benjamin then
돈 없어서 못 올까봐 돈 자루도 도로 넣어서 보내주는데 여관에서 확인한: He even puts their money sacks back in, in case they can't come because they have no money, and when the brothers check at the inn, they freak out. ‘Who's playing games at a time like this?’ But what can they do? First they have to eat and survive.
돌아가서 자초지종을 이야기 하는데 야곱이 볼 때는 시므온 팔아서 양식 사: They go back and explain everything, but to Jacob it looks like they sold Simeon to buy food. These guys have a record, right?
- 얼마 안가 양식이 떨어집니다. 유다가 나서서 어려운 이야기를 함. 베:
- Before long the food runs out. Judah steps up and says the hard thing. Without bringing Benjamin, they can't buy food. Absolutely not. They're going to starve to death anyway, so what choice is there? 'If I be bereaved, I am bereaved,' and he lets him go.
 - In the end, everything Jacob loved (Rachel, money, Joseph, Benjamin, the firstborn's blessing) disappears.
He was holding on to Benjamin as the last one, but God is telling him to let go of even that.
- 베냐민까지 데려온 형님들과 요셉은 갇혀 있던 시므온까지 꺼내와서 거창: - Joseph brings out Simeon, who had been locked up, too, and has a grand meal with the brothers, who even brought Benjamin. He seats the brothers exactly in order of age, and they go, ‘Whoa~ he must be a god.’ He gives Benjamin five portions. A big brother's heart.  After crying his heart out, he sends the brothers off with food.
그 때 유다가 나서서 전에 돈이 그대로 있어서 이번에 가지고 왔다고 이야:
At that point Judah steps up and says that last time their money was still there, so they brought it back this time.
 Joseph feels his brothers have changed a little. In the old days they'd have just kept quiet and pocketed it, but they honestly brought it back.
- They found Simeon, they get to take Benjamin home, they have food, they got money.. it's like walking on clouds.  But Joseph still couldn't trust them, so to keep only Benjamin, he puts his silver cup in Benjamin's bag and sends a posse after them.
- 첫째부터 곡식 짐을 다 풀어 헤치는데도 안나오고 베냐민 차례인데 베냐: - They open up every grain sack starting from the eldest, and it doesn't turn up, and now it's Benjamin's turn, and they're about to say Benjamin is a good kid and wouldn't do such a thing, ‘See, what did I tell you?’ but then
베냐민이 잡혀가니까 모든 형님들이 옷을 찢으면서 애굽까지 따라갑니다. 다: When Benjamin is taken, all the brothers tear their clothes and follow him all the way to Egypt. Seeing his brothers come back, Joseph feels like he's been hit. He'd tried to get Benjamin out because he thought Benjamin would suffer among the brothers who had tried to kill him and sold him off, but seeing that the brothers had become united through those hard days, he's shocked
유다가 나서서 자초지종을 설명하고 베냐민 대신 자신을 노예로 잡아달라고: Judah steps up, explains everything, and weeps, begging him to take him as a slave in Benjamin's place, and the other brothers fall down wailing too, and seeing this, Joseph can't hold back his feelings and tells them he's Joseph.
<창45:5> 당신들이 나를 이 곳에 팔았으므로 근심하지 마소서 한탄하지: <Gen 45:5> Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.
- 첫 아들을 므낫세라 지으면서 나로 나의 모든 고난과 나의 아비의 온: - When he named his first son Manasseh, he lamented that God had ‘made me forget’ all my toil and all my father's house. Now he came to understand God's great plan of salvation, so much that he was ashamed of that lament.
여러분 요셉은 꿈의 사람이 아니었어요. 만약에 요셉이 꿈 하나 붙들고 사: You know, Joseph wasn't a man of dreams. If Joseph had been someone living by holding on to one dream, he'd have already lost his mind when his brothers almost killed him, when he was sold as a slave to Egypt, when he was framed and sent to prison again.
성경을 꼼꼼히 읽어보면 요셉을 어려운 일이 있을 때마다 자기 꿈을 떠올리: If you read the Bible carefully, Joseph didn't take strength by remembering his dreams every time something hard happened. The Bible records that he only remembered the dreams when he saw his brothers had changed.
그런데 뮤지컬이든 애니메이션이든 다 보면 요셉이 자기가 꾼 꿈 하나 붙들: But whether it's a musical or an animated film, they all make Joseph look like someone living by holding on to the dream he had. That comes from not reading the Bible properly.
아무튼 요셉은 이제 형들을 안심 시킵니다. 죽이지 않겠다. 부모님들과 형: Anyway, now Joseph reassures his brothers. I won't kill you. He tells them he'll take care of their parents, the brothers, and the nephews, and tells them to bring them down to Egypt.
How much they cried when he met Joseph.... it was heard all the way to Pharaoh's palace. Pharaoh invites them. As soon as Pharaoh sees Jacob, he looks so old that Pharaoh asks his age. He says he's lived 130 years and they've been hard years. In the end it was his own fault.
- 전능하신 하나님께서 야곱의 오그라진 손을 펴시는데, 야곱의 자아를 깨: - It took 130 years for God Almighty to open Jacob's clenched fist, to break Jacob's self.
- 애굽으로 내려간 후 17년을 더 사는데 거룩하고 신령한 삶을 살게 됨: - After going down to Egypt he lives 17 more years, and he lives a holy and spiritual life.  He blesses Pharaoh, he prophesies his sons' future. Once he let go of greed and stubbornness, his spirit became clear and clean, and he was born again.
- 야곱의 이야기가 끝나자 요셉의 이야기도 많은데 함께 마무리 지음. 성: - When Jacob's story ends, Joseph's story, though there's a lot of it, is wrapped up along with it. The Bible is focused on Jacob.
⑨ 복 받은 아브라함과 이삭의 이야기(12~26장)보다 험악한 세월을 보: ⑨ Why is there so much more of the story of Jacob, who had hard years (chapters 25~50), than the story of blessed Abraham and Isaac (chapters 12~26)?
- 보통 아브라함과 이삭 보다 야곱처럼 살기 때문.\n - 하나님의 사람:
- Because most of us live more like Jacob than like Abraham and Isaac.
 - We need to look at ourselves through the lives of God's people.
Mahatma Gandhi - “I love Jesus. But I don't like Christians. Because they are not like Jesus.”
풍요 속에 빈곤 - 성경이 없는 사람은 없는데 성경을 바르게 이해하고 실: Poverty in the midst of plenty - there's nobody without a Bible, but people who understand the Bible rightly and live it out are rare. I hope you meet God personally in this good season of your life.
자 이렇게 창세기를 정리하고 우리 출애굽기로~: Okay, with that, let's wrap up Genesis and on to Exodus~
